resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and Firelookout tie the water-tower platform to about 1939. The 1937 construction records on the Forest Lookouts page and the Roaming Civic date the cab to 1937. The story gives 1937 for the cab and mentions the 1939 date.
NHLR gives 253 ft (77 m), which matches the record's 77.1 m. Firelookout and the Cherylhill directory give 240 ft. The record was left unchanged; elevation is not part of the story.
The 1937 to 1965 tower and tank are reported at 47, 52, 60 and 70 feet across the Forest Lookouts page. The story gives the range rather than picking one figure.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1996 build date is right for the current steel tower; the first lookout on this site was a 1937 cab on a water tank, removed in 1965. Access is set to restricted from a 2021 visit report and the compound layout. No official current visitor policy was found, so this should be checked with the association. The elevation conflict (77 m vs 240 ft) is left open. No photos added.
